alice: Heads-up — product asked for a per-customer "shunt" (sticky-route) feature. Customer can opt into a header that pins requests to their dedicated pool for X minutes. Need console toggle + audit log and a safe escape hatch.
ben: Can we trust a client-sent header? header spoofing is real. Need HMAC or signed token, or else this is a denial/over-provision vector. @sec-bot thoughts? :thinking_face: 
sec-bot: Recommend HMAC-signed header with rotating keys + KMS integration. Also require org-level allowlist in console. Reject unsigned headers.
carla: Billing/quotas note — when pinned to dedicated pool we need to surface token-level cost and sys load in console. If they hit quota, auto-fallback to shared path (configurable). Also suggest TTL for the pin so it expires.
dave: CDN and API GW may strip weird headers. We should accept either: `X-Redwood-Org-Shunt` OR include org claim inside existing JWT to avoid strip issues. Also add an escape-hatch API that ops can call to revoke all pins for an org.
alice: Good points. Proposed MVP: 1) Signed header + key rotation 2) Console checkbox to enable shunt for org + allowlist UI 3) Pin TTL (default 15m, editable) 4) Revoke button + audit events 5) telemetry tag `shunt:true` on routed requests.
ben: Telemetry: add metrics for pin-hit, pin-miss, fallback-rate, and per-org latency/cost diff. Alert on >5% fallback-rate for 10m.
carla: UX: in Rollouts console show pins as a separate column, and expose recent revocations. For canary we should allow rolling enable for a subset of orgs.
dave: Internal API change: gateway needs `Accept-Shunt` boolean in routing response so downstream placement can update metrics. Minimal contract change.
deploy-bot: deploy started for shunt-service v0.1 -> prod-env-a (canary 5%). logs: `shunt: feature flag on for orgs: none`
alice: Action items: @ben spec telemetry+alerts, @carla console mocks, @dave gateway contract PR, @sec-bot HMAC key flow. We'll do a 5% canary then 30% for 24h.
ben: I'll add a lightweight eval to compare token-cost delta per-org over 24h during canary.
alice: OK. Thanks team. Will post RFC doc later (short one). :thumbsup:
